description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HealthController, providing a simple health check endpoint at '/health'. It is designed for lightweight environment checks without exposing full actuator health details.

classes.name: HealthController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller that provides a health check endpoint for basic service availability.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/health' and returns a simple string 'ok' to verify that the service is running.
